Report.vw_CBS: This view contains information on Projects' Cost Breakdown Structure. It can be used for EVM (Earned Value Management) module.
Report.vw_Projects: This view contains general information on Projects, like Name, Type, Status, project's location and other cutom fields
Report.vw_Contracts: A comprehensive reporting view of contracts that captures contract identity, associated projects, status and progress, key dates, financial values, payment activity, and administrative form details for lifecycle tracking and analysis.
Report.vw_Invoice: This view contains information on Projects' Invoices. Invoices are always connected to contacts as well.
Report.vw_Issues: This view contains information on Projects' Issues. Inforrmation like status and severity.
Report.vw_OrganizationUnit: This view contains List of Organization units. Organization units of one of 3 stakeholder types in the software. Other type of stakeholders and natural and legal types.
Report.vw_OrganizationUnitType: This view contains information on Organization unit types. This view may be used in filtering and grouping.
Report.vw_OrganUnitScurve: This view provide timed data on aggregated plan and actual progress of projects within organization units. It is used to create progress charts in organization units level.
Report.vw_Payments: This view contains information on Projects' Payments. Payments can be connected to contacts and invoices.
Report.vw_Photos: This view contains information on Projects' Photo files.
Report.vw_PlanHistory: 'A historical snapshot table that records each project plan’s WBS hierarchy, names, creation time, and planned start/end dates, stored in both Gregorian and Jalali calendar formats.
Report.vw_ProjectGroup: This view provide lists Portfolios. Portfolios are hierarchical groups of projects,
Report.vw_ProjectGroupScurve: This view provide timed data on aggregated plan and actual progress of projects within Portfolio. It is used to create progress charts in Portfolio level.
Report.vw_ProjectMonthlyReport: This view is part of construction module and provides information on a project's previouse month activities
Report.vw_ProjectPlanProgress: Plan progress of projects by date
Report.vw_ProjectScurve: This view provide timed data on aggregated plan and actual progress of projects It is used to create progress charts in projectlevel.
Report.vw_ResourceUsage: This view contains information on Resource usage of projects. Resources are typically Material, Cost and Work and can be imported from project's schedule or manually entered
Report.vw_Risks: This view contains information on Projects' Issues. Inforrmation like status and Probabilty and Impact.
Report.vw_WBS: This view contains information on Projects' Work Breakdown Structure.
Report.vw_WorkItems: This view contains information on Projects' Work Items or Activities. WIs are the smallest block in WBS and contain one or more Data Form Items.
